'''Londar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was a [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].

He was also stationed on [[Section X]] at [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] but during the [[Dread War]], he was stationed in the [[Dread Executioners camp]] on the [[moon]] [[Oricon]] as part of the [[Dread Executioners]].

During the [[Revanite crisis]], Londar was stationed on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] as a member of the [[Yavin Coalition]].<ref name="SOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Londar serves as Modification Vendor for Level 54 in multiple areas within the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He appears as Modification Vendor for Level 56 players on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SOR" />
